description: This file defines a final class 'Serializer' within the Laminas\Diactoros\Response namespace. It provides static methods to serialize and deserialize HTTP response messages from strings and streams, including methods to generate string representations of responses and parse response status lines.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A final class responsible for serializing and deserializing HTTP responses, facilitating conversion between string/stream formats and PSR-7 Response objects.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Deserialize a response string into a Response object.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Parse a response from a stream into a Response object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Create a string representation of a Response object.

methods.name: getStatusLine
methods.description: Retrieve the HTTP status line components (version, status, reason) from a stream.
